skills.description: Using a plant-monitoring platform that periodically (e.g., daily) collects plant images, environmental data, and growth metrics (new bud count, leaf-area change, leaf color), an AI evaluation model fuses leaf color (chlorophyll index), morphology (spread, leaf size), and growth dynamics (new buds, leaf-area growth rate) to output an overall vitality score from 0-100 along with a trend (rising / stable / declining).
